content.text:
Since #380, `pi-assistant.yml` installs npm 12.2.0 globally before pi-action runs. npm 12 defaults `allow-git` to `none` (npm 11.19.1 on the runner defaults to `all`), and pi-action installs `extensions` with that global npm. So `github:cv/pit#v0.36.3` is refused:

```
npm error code EALLOWGIT
npm error Fetching packages of type "git" have been disabled
```

That's why pi failed on #383 ([run 43591562635](https://github.com/cv/pit/actions/runs/43591562635)).

This sets `NPM_CONFIG_ALLOW_GIT: all` on the pi-action step only, so the `npm ci` step keeps npm 12's stricter default.

Checked locally with npm 12.2.0: `npm install github:cv/pit#v0.36.3` fails with `EALLOWGIT` without the variable and succeeds with it.

A fix in pi-action itself (passing `--allow-git` for git specs) would cover other workflows that upgrade npm. That's a separate follow-up.
[".github/workflows/pi-assistant.yml"]
diff --git a/.github/workflows/pi-assistant.yml b/.github/workflows/pi-assistant.yml
index 6135e95d..3aa7ffad 100644
--- a/.github/workflows/pi-assistant.yml
+++ b/.github/workflows/pi-assistant.yml
@@ -78,6 +78,10 @@ jobs:
 
       - name: Run pi-action
         uses: cv/pi-action@753f11099794ad93567438fdd1b94f1fd2f79d59 # v2.5.2
+        env:
+          # npm 12, installed above, refuses git specs by default (allow-git=none); pi-action installs
+          # `extensions` with it, and github:cv/pit is a git spec.
+          NPM_CONFIG_ALLOW_GIT: all
         with:
           github_token: ${{ steps.app.outputs.token }}
           provider: nvidia
11.19.1
v24.22.3
